root.label: Colombia approves extradition of five suspects to United States

events.label: Colombia approves extradition of five suspects to United States

slots.name: suspects approved
slots.sentence: In recent days, the president also gave the green light for the extradition to the United States of five suspects whose handover had been suspended as part of the peace process promoted by the previous administration — a process de La Espriella formally concluded through resolutions issued Friday.
